newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BURSWOOD SAYS HIGH-ROLLER COMPETITION RISES.
newsitem.headline: BURSWOOD SAYS HIGH-ROLLER COMPETITION RISES.

text.p: Burswood Property Trust, the owner and operator of the Burswood casino in Perth, said on Thursday that competition for high-stakes gamblers internationally has increased significantly.
Burswood earlier on Thursday reported a net profit rose to A$42.42 million in the year ended June 30 from A$38.73 million the previous year.
Burswood said it saw an increase in international high level players in the second half of 1996/97 from the first half, although its win percentage was lower.
The result was a decline in gaming revenue in the second half from the first, Burswood said.
The company also said difficult economic conditions and declining currency values in some key markets weighed on business activity in 1996/97.
